recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast surrealist composition featuring a black bowler hat silhouette that morphs into a jagged, profile-like shape containing a grid of four high-contrast halftone portraits, all set against a vibrant solid blue background.
coreVisualRelationships: The bowler hat acts as a container for the primary title text.
The lower silhouette extension serves as a frame for photographic halftone elements.
A stark white border separates the black central graphic from the blue field.
A diagonal white banner in the top-left corner provides a secondary information zone.
coreInvariants: Black silhouette with a thick white outline
High-contrast black and white halftone photography
Single red accent character within the main title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical axis, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large black bowler hat silhouette in the upper-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left diagonal banner, moves to the central title inside the hat, then descends into the halftone portraits and the tracklist on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive solid blue areas on the left and right margins create a focused, centered impact.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with maximum value contrast (black vs white) in the foreground elements.

characterSpecificRedesigns: One specific uppercase letter is rendered in red to break the monochromatic text block.

composition.position: Inside the crown of the hat

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy geometric display face paired with a functional, condensed sans-serif for lists.
graphicDevices: Thick white keyline around central shape

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, clean geometric feel of the 70s era.
Provides the necessary weight and impact for the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid cobalt blue background. In the center, place a black silhouette of a bowler hat that extends downward into a jagged, profile-like shape. The entire black shape must have a thick white outline. Inside the lower jagged part, place four high-contrast black and white halftone portraits in a 2x2 grid. Include a white diagonal banner in the top-left corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a heavy geometric sans-serif, centered inside the hat crown, stacked in three lines. Color the first letter of the third line red, and the rest white. Add a right-aligned list of text in a smaller white sans-serif to the left of the lower silhouette.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, vibrant blue?
Is the central shape a black bowler hat with a white outline?
Are the portraits rendered in high-contrast halftone?
Is there a single red letter in the main title block?

adjustableVariables: Number of portraits in the grid
Specific letter chosen for the red accent
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
Exact facial features of the portraits

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp vector edges for the silhouette

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white outline is consistent in thickness.
Check that the halftone dots are visible and not blurred.
Verify the red letter stands out clearly against the black background.
Confirm the diagonal banner is perfectly straight.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central Silhouette + Halftone Grid + Geometric Display Type + Solid Primary Color Background
